messages.text: Please run exactly this one command and report its output: crontab -l

Ran it. Result:

```
$ crontab -l
no crontab for aika
```

Exit code **1**, no stdout at all — the message is on stderr. That's the normal "you have no crontab" response, not an error in the command itself. The user `aika` has no personal crontab installed.

A couple of notes in case they matter to you:

- This is the *user* crontab only. If you meant system-wide scheduled jobs, those live in `/etc/crontab`, `/etc/cron.d/`, and `/etc/cron.{hourly,daily,weekly,monthly}/` — say the word and I'll look there instead.
- QwenPaw has its own scheduler (`qwenpaw cron list --agent-id ...`), which is separate from system `cron`. If you're trying to figure out what I have scheduled, that's the right place to check, not `crontab`.
